A journey by train is one of the most memorable experiences a person can have. It is always fascinating. It charms our minds and makes us happy.

A journey is a break in our monotonous everyday life. After a journey, we feel relaxed and fresh. Peace fills our heart after we have made a wonderful journey.

My first train journey took place last year, during a family tour from Dhaka to Rangpur, and it remains as one of the brightest memories of my childhood. We were travelling overnight, and my excitement started long before we reached Kamalapur Railway Station. The members of the trip were me, my parents and younger sister.

On the day of the journey, we woke up early in the morning. We had our breakfast and took a cab to Kamalapur Railway Station. We reached the station at 8 and were welcomed with the cool announcements of the train schedules. Vendors were walking around selling jhalmuri, biscuits and water bottles.

We boarded the Rangpur Express at 8:30. We found our seats and settled in. At exactly 9 pm, the whistle blew and train slowly began to move. The steady sound of wheels on the tracks made the journey feel warm and comforting.

The train quickly took off with great speed. We could feel as the environment slowly shifted around us. Buildings were becoming less frequent and more and more greenery could be seen. The rural environment brought a strange peace of mind.

At noon, we took our lunch on the train. We were given khichuri and chicken curry. Chutney was also available. Sides were also being given out. After lunch I started reading a book I brought. Many people used this time to take a quick nap.

At evening the cabin crew came out and handed us all with snacks. We were each given a pack of biscuits. We could also order tea, milk tea, coffee or sandwiches.

The night journey was even more thrilling. It was peaceful compared to the busy life we experience everyday.

At night, we were given light food. We were given ruti and vegetable curry. Those who preferred meat could also request for chicken curry.

After dinner we took a walk within the train cabins. We observed how other people were passing their time. Some were chatting, some were on their phones and some were looking out the window. We brushed our teeth and returned to our cabin for the night.

By the morning, we were very close to our destination. We were served bread, boiled eggs and bananas for breakfast. At last, at 10, we reached Rangpur Station. Kulis were helping people getting their luggage down. Finally, we got ready and left our cabin. Thus our wonderful journey ended very beautifully.

A train journey is truly a wonderful experience of modern transport. I will remember my very first train journey for the rest of my life.

<SUMM> A journey by train is a fascinating and memorable experience that refreshes the mind and breaks the monotony of daily life. My first train journey took place last year during an overnight family tour from Dhaka to Rangpur with my parents and younger sister. We reached Kamalapur Railway Station at 8:00, boarded the Rangpur Express at 8:30, and the train left at 9:00. As the train sped through the countryside, we enjoyed the beautiful green scenery and peaceful rural environment. During the journey we were served khichuri and chicken curry for lunch, biscuits and drinks in the evening, ruti with vegetable or chicken curry for dinner, and bread, boiled eggs, and bananas for breakfast. I also read a book, walked through the train cabins, and observed fellow passengers chatting, using their phones, or looking out the windows. We reached Rangpur Station at 10 the next morning, where kulis helped unload luggage. The journey was comfortable, enjoyable, and unforgettable, and I will remember my first train journey for the rest of my life. </SUMM>
